extracted text: A gel with the following molar composition 0.8:0.4:0.4:38 SiO2:GeO2:ROH:H2O was prepared by dissolving amorphous germanium dioxide (0.609 g, 5.82 mmol, 99.999% Acros) in a 0.584 M solution of the SDA, (6R,10S)-6,10-dimethyl-5-azoniaspiro[4,5]decane hydroxide (10 ml, 5.84 mmol). Tetraethyl orthosilicate (2.094 g, 10.05 mmol, 98% Aldrich) was added dropwise and, to enrich the final zeolite, 29Si-enriched tetraethyl orthosilicate (0.333 g, 1.59 mmol, >99 at% 29Si CortecNet) was added. This was stirred at room temperature for 2 h. The solution was then transferred to a Teflon-lined autoclave (23 ml, Parr Instruments) and heated at 175 °C for 13 days under static conditions. The solid was recovered by filtration, washed with copious amounts of distilled water and dried overnight. To remove the occluded SDA the zeolite was heated to 575 °C at a rate of 1 °C min–1, held at 575 °C for 6 h and cooled to room temperature at a rate of 2 °C min–1 under an atmosphere of air.
property mapping: SiO2 -> Si, GeO2 -> Ge, ROH -> osda_ratios (where R is the organic structure directing agent), H2O -> H2O, (6R,10S)-6,10-dimethyl-5-azoniaspiro[4,5]decane hydroxide -> osda_names, 175 °C -> crystallization_temperature, 13 days -> crystallization_time, UTL -> product_names
formula abbreviations: ROH refers to the structure directing agent (6R,10S)-6,10-dimethyl-5-azoniaspiro[4,5]decane hydroxide. The OH component is part of the structure directing agent rather than being counted separately.
